services.health: code=$(kubectl -n "$NAMESPACE" exec journey-mcp-client -- curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' http://log-debug-context-mcp:8080/mcp 2>/dev/null) && [ "$code" = 401 ]
